votes.motion: to approve the minutes of March 10, 2021

that we forward a recommendation to the Midvale City Council to approve rezoning of 532, 544, and 562 E Fort Union Blvd from Single Family Residential with Duplex and 7200 South Overlays to the Mixed Use Zone with 7200 Overlay with the following findings: 1. The proposed rezoning is consistent with the goals of the 2016 Midvale City General Plan, including the 2019 Housing Plan, and 2. The land and its surrounding environs have changed to such a degree that it is in the public interest to encourage redevelopment and recognize the changed character of the area

that we approve a Conditional Use Permit, Small Scale Master Plan, and the Preliminary Site Plan for the 17-unit Palais 550 Townhome Master Planned Development at 532-568 E Fort Union Blvd and forward a recommendation to the Midvale City Council to approve the Rezone and Preliminary Plat with the findings and conditions of approval recommended in the staff report

that we forward a recommendation to the Midvale City Council to approve the 17-Lot Preliminary Subdivision Plat for 532-568 E Fort Union Blvd with the findings and conditions of approval recommended in the staff report

that we approve a conditional use permit for the flag lot and proposed twin homes and forward a recommendation to the Midvale City Council to approve the Mid 6 Twin Homes Preliminary Plat at 7039/7045 S 300 E with the findings and conditions of approval in the Staff Report
that we forward a recommendation to the City Council to deny the proposed text amendment modifying open space standards for master planned developments in the RM-12 zone
